Package metadata sourceReference is taken in PerforceDownloader (doInstall/doDownload), getLabelFromSourceReference() returns the substring after '@', and Perforce::syncCodeBase() concatenates that value into a string command as '@' . $sourceReference then ProcessExecutor::execute(). At 2.9.5, ProcessExecutor::execute() on a string uses Process::fromShellCommandline(), so shell metacharacters in the suffix run before p4. Confirmed on tag 2.9.5 at src/Composer/Downloader/PerforceDownloader.php:41-50,56-67 and src/Composer/Util/Perforce.php:348-355; same extractor/sink on 2.2.26 at PerforceDownloader.php:40-49,60-67 and Perforce.php:441-447.
